l-e-h1-b01-01.topic: Ụda okwu ndị na-ejikọta nkebi ahịrịokwu
l-e-h1-b01-01.goal: Lelee ma echiche na a pụghị iji that kọwaa mmadụ n’ahịrịokwu mmekọrịta ọ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-h1-b01-01.material: Echiche: N’ime nkebi ahịrịokwu mmekọrịta, a pụghị iji that kọwaa mmadụ. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide echiche a.
l-e-h1-b01-01.s.s1.r.a: That na-akọwa ihe, ya mere ọ naghị emegide echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: E ji who mee ihe. Ọ bụghị ihe atụ nke that na-akọwa mmadụ.
l-e-h1-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: A na-eji which akọwa ihe, ya mere o kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b01-01.s.s1.explain: A na-eji that akọwa mmadụ na ihe. N’ahịrịokwu The man that lives here, that na-akọwa nwoke ahụ, onye bụ mmadụ.

l-e-h1-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma echiche na ahịrịokwu ọ bụla malitere na Because anaghị ezu oke bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-h1-b01-02.material: Echiche: Ahịrịokwu malitere na Because anaghị ezu oke (ọ kwụsịghị echiche) mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide echiche a.
l-e-h1-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere naanị ihe kpatara ya, enweghị ihe si na ya pụta. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b01-02.s.s1.r.b: O nwere naanị nkebi na-egosi ihe kpatara ya, ya mere o zughị oke. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b01-02.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dịghị ihe sochiri ya, ya mere o zughị oke. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b01-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na nkebi ahịrịokwu bụ isi nke na-akọ ihe si na ya pụta esochi nkebi Because, ahịrịokwu ahụ ezuola oke. Ọ dị mma ka nkebi ihe kpatara ya buru ụzọ.
l-e-h1-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: We stayed in sochiri Because it rained ma mepụta ahịrịokwu zuru oke; ya mere echiche ahụ ezighị ezi.

l-e-h1-b01-03.title: Ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ ọ na-abụ nchịkọta mgbe niile?
l-e-h1-b01-03.goal: Lelee ma echiche na ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ nke ederede na-achịkọta ederede ahụ dum bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere ya).
l-e-h1-b01-03.material: Echiche: Ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ nke ederede na-achịkọta ederede ahụ dum mgbe niile. Ederede: “Mkpụrụ na-agbasa n’ụzọ dị iche iche. Ụfọdụ na-efe n’ikuku, ụfọdụ na-arapara n’ajị anụ. Ole na ole na-agakwa n’ime nnụnụ.”
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.prompt: Ụdị ihe atụ dị aṅaa ka ederede a bụ maka echiche ahụ?
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.r.a: O nwere isi echiche: mkpụrụ na-agbasa n’ụzọ dị iche iche.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere echiche ahụ n’ihi na ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụ naanị ihe atụ nkọwa.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ n’ihi na ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụ nchịkọta.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụ naanị otu ihe atụ, banyere ịnya ụgbọ n’ime nnụnụ.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere echiche ahụ n’ihi na ahịrịokwu mbụ bụ naanị ihe atụ nkọwa.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu mbụ bụ isi echiche, ọ bụghị ihe atụ nkọwa.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu mbụ bụ isi echiche, ndị ọzọ niile bụkwa ihe atụ. Ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụkwa otu ihe atụ naanị, gbasara ịnyịnya ụgbọ n'ahụ nnụnụ.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụ otu ihe atụ nke mkpụrụ osisi na-agba nnụnụ, ya mere ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ abụghị nchịkọta mgbe niile.
l-e-h1-b01-03.s.s2.model.1: Isi ihe dị n'ahịrịokwu mbụ, njedebe bụkwa ihe atụ nkọwa, ya mere ederede a bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h1-b02-01.goal: Lelee ma echiche na a na-eji whose naanị maka okwu na-akọwa mmadụ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị.
l-e-h1-b02-01.material: Echiche: A na-eji whose naanị maka okwu na-akọwa mmadụ. Chọta okwu na-emegide echiche a.
l-e-h1-b02-01.s.s1.r.a: Onye nwere igwe bụ mmadụ. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-01.s.s1.r.b: Onye nwe klas bụ mmadụ. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-01.s.s1.r.c: Onye nwe nkịta bụ mmadụ. Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-01.s.s1.explain: Whose na-egosi ihe onye nwe ya. N’ime the house whose roof, ọ na-ekwu maka elu ụlọ nke ụlọ, nke bụ ihe; ya mere a na-ejikwa ya maka ihe.
l-e-h1-b02-01.s.s2.model.0: N’ime the house whose roof, whose na-akọwa house, ihe; ya mere echiche na a na-eji ya naanị maka mmadụ ezighị ezi.

l-e-h1-b02-02.goal: Lelee ma a na-etinye rikoma mgbe niile ozugbo However gasịrị; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere nke a.

l-e-h1-b02-02.s.s1.r.b: E nwere rikoma ozugbo However gachara. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-02.s.s1.r.c: Rikoma dị ozugbo n’azụ ya, ya mere ọ dabara n’echiche ahụ.

l-e-h1-b02-03.title: A na-ede isi echiche n’ime ederede mgbe niile?
l-e-h1-b02-03.goal: Lelee ma a na-ede isi echiche mgbe niile dịka otu ahịrịokwu n’ime ederede; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-h1-b02-03.material: Echiche: A na-ede isi echiche mgbe niile kpọmkwem dịka otu ahịrịokwu n’ederede. Ederede: “Onye njem ahụ kwadebere map, oriọna na mmiri ọzọ. Ọ nyochara ihu igwe ugboro abụọ ma gwa enyi ụzọ ọ ga-eso.”
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.o.a: Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ n’ihi na ahịrịokwu mbụ bụ isi echiche.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu mbụ na-ekwu naanị ihe e kwadebere. Ọ kọwaghị ederede ahụ dum.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ n’echiche ahụ n’ihi na ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụ isi echiche.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrịokwu ikpeazụ bụ naanị otu ihe e mere; o jikọtaghị ihe niile.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere echiche ahụ n’ihi na enweghị ahịrịokwu bụ isi.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.o.d: Ederede na-enweghị isi echiche ma ọlị
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.r.d: Enwere ike ịchọpụta isi echiche site n’ọtụtụ ihe e mere iji kwadebe.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s1.explain: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ bụ nkọwa. A ga-ekwupụta isi echiche, “kwadebere nke ọma,” site n’ijikọta ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ dịghị otu ahịrịokwu na-akọwa ihe niile, ya mere a ga-ewepụta isi echiche n’onwe ya; nke a na-eme ka echiche ahụ bụrụ ihe na-ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b02-03.s.s2.model.1: A na-achọpụta isi echiche naanị site n’ijikọta ihe a kwadebere na ihe ndị e nyochara; ya mere ederede a na-emegide echiche ahụ.

l-e-h1-b03-03.title: Ederede nwere naanị eziokwu ọ̀ nweghị isi echiche?
l-e-h1-b03-03.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta na ederede nke eziokwu n'enweghị echiche enweghị isi echiche bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h1-b03-03.material: Nkwupụta: Ederede nwere naanị eziokwu na-enweghị echiche sitere n'onye dere enweghị isi echiche. Ederede: “Octopuses have three hearts. Two pump blood to the gills, and one pumps it to the body.”
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.o.a: Ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ: ọ nwere naanị eziokwu, ya mere enweghị isi echiche
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.r.a: E nwere isi echiche: octopus nwere obi atọ.
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.o.b: Ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ: ọ nwere naanị eziokwu mana nwee isi echiche
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.o.c: Ihe atụ na-enweghị njikọ na nkwupụta ahụ: ọ nwere echiche
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.r.c: Ederede ahụ enweghị okwu na-egosi echiche.
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.o.d: Ederede nke enweghị ike ịmata isi echiche ya
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.r.d: Obi atọ ahụ na ihe ha na-eme bụ isi echiche nke ederede ahụ.
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s1.explain: Ọbụna na naanị eziokwu, ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ na-abịa ọnụ dị ka otu ọdịnaya (obi atọ nke octopus), ya mere e nwere isi echiche.
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ na-akọwa obi atọ nke octopus, ya mere e nwere isi echiche ọbụna n'enweghị echiche, ma nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b03-03.s.s2.model.1: Eziokwu na-aghọkwa isi echiche mgbe ha na-abịa ọnụ gburugburu otu ọdịnaya, ya mere ederede a bụ ihe atụ megidere.

l-e-h1-b05-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "a relative clause always begins with a relative pronoun" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, wee chọta ma kọwaa ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-h1-b05-01.material: Nkwupụta: Nkebiokwu relative na-amalite mgbe niile site na nnochi aha relative. Chọta ahịrị okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h1-b05-01.s.s1.r.b: Nkebiokwu relative na-amalite site na whom. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-01.s.s1.r.c: Nkebiokwu relative na-amalite site na that. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-01.s.s1.r.d: Nkebiokwu relative na-amalite site na who. Nke a bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-01.s.s1.explain: N'in which we live, nkebiokwu relative na-amalite site na okwu ọnọdụ in. Nnochi aha relative nwere ike ịghara ịbịa nke mbụ.
l-e-h1-b05-01.s.s2.model.0: In which we live na-amalite site na okwu ọnọdụ in, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ na-amalite site na nnochi aha relative adịghị mma.
l-e-h1-b05-01.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji nnochi aha relative mgbe okwu ọnọdụ, nkebiokwu na-amalite site na okwu ọnọdụ, ya mere ọ bụghị otú ahụ mgbe niile.

l-e-h1-b05-09.title: And ọ̀ pụtara ịgbakwunye mgbe niile?
l-e-h1-b05-09.topic: Ihe dị iche iche and pụtara
l-e-h1-b05-09.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta 'and always means adding two things, like "and"' bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-h1-b05-09.material: Nkwupụta: and always means adding two things, like 'and'. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h1-b05-09.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-agbakwunye nri abụọ. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-09.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-agbakwunye omume abụọ. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-09.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-agbakwunye mkpụrụ osisi abụọ. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-09.s.s1.explain: and mgbe iwu pụtara 'mgbe ahụ' ma na-ejikọta ọnọdụ na nsonaazụ. Ọ naghị apụta naanị ịgbakwunye.
l-e-h1-b05-09.s.s2.model.0: Study hard, and you will pass pụtara 'If you study hard, you will pass', ya mere ọ bụghị and na-agbakwunye naanị.
l-e-h1-b05-09.s.s2.model.1: and mgbe iwu na-eduga n'nsonaazụ mgbe ọnọdụ, ya mere ọ bụghị 'and' mgbe niile.

l-e-h1-b05-25.title: Nkebi participle ọ na-egosi naanị oge?
l-e-h1-b05-25.goal: Tụlee ma echiche na nkebi participle na-egosi oge mgbe niile ọ bụ eziokwu; chọta ihe atụ megidere ya, kọwaa ya.
l-e-h1-b05-25.material: Echiche: Nkebi participle malitere na -ing na-egosi oge mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide ya.
l-e-h1-b05-25.s.s1.r.a: I turned on the light as I went in. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-egosi oge.
l-e-h1-b05-25.s.s1.r.c: I smelled smoke when I opened the door. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-egosi oge.
l-e-h1-b05-25.s.s1.r.d: I saw a swan as I walked. Ọ bụ ihe atụ na-egosi oge.
l-e-h1-b05-25.s.s1.explain: Having no money na-egosi ihe kpatara ije ahụ: enweghị ego. Nkebi participle anaghị egosi naanị oge.
l-e-h1-b05-25.s.s2.model.0: Having no money na-egosi ihe kpatara ya, “n’ihi na ego adịghị”; ya mere echiche na ọ na-egosi naanị oge ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-25.s.s2.model.1: Nkebi participle nwekwara ike igosi ihe kpatara ya ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ; ya mere ọ bụghị eziokwu na ọ na-egosi naanị oge.

l-e-h1-b05-33.title: Ọ bụrụ na will dị, ọ̀ bụ ọdịnihu?
l-e-h1-b05-33.topic: Ihe dị iche nke will pụtara
l-e-h1-b05-33.goal: Chee echiche ma nkwupụta 'ọ bụrụ na will dị n'ahịrịokwu, ọ bụ banyere ọdịnihu' bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ikpe ebe ọ bụghị eziokwu (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ya.
l-e-h1-b05-33.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu nwere will na-ekwu banyere ọdịnihu mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h1-b05-33.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ banyere echi, ya mere ọ bụ ọdịnihu. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-33.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ banyere elekere 6, ya mere ọ bụ ọdịnihu. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-33.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ banyere abalị a, ya mere ọ bụ ọdịnihu. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-33.s.s1.explain: Oil will float on water na-eji will maka eziokwu n'ozuzu nke bụ eziokwu mgbe niile. Ọ bụghị banyere ọdịnihu.
l-e-h1-b05-33.s.s2.model.0: Oil will float on water na-ekwu eziokwu n'ozuzu nke bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ya mere ọbụna na will ọ bụghị ọdịnihu.
l-e-h1-b05-33.s.s2.model.1: Enweghị oge ọdịnihu kpọmkwem ma ọ pụtara na ọ bụ otú ahụ mgbe niile, ya mere ọbụna na will ọ bụghị ọdịnihu.

l-e-h1-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: Relative adverb where na-eji naanị mgbe noun maka ebe. Chọta okwu nke na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h1-b06-01.s.s1.r.a: Ụlọ bụ ebe. Ọ bụ ihe atụ nke dabara n'nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-h1-b06-25.title: Past participle bụ passive mgbe niile?
l-e-h1-b06-25.topic: Past participles nke ngwaa na-enweghị ihe
l-e-h1-b06-25.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta "a past participle that modifies a noun always has a passive meaning" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ọnọdụ ọ na-abụghị (ihe atụ megidere), ma kọwaa ha.
l-e-h1-b06-25.material: Nkwupụta: Past participle na-akọwa aha nwere ihe ọ pụtara passive mgbe niile, "a na-eme ya ihe". Chọta okwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-h1-b06-25.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ windo nke onye gbajiri. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-25.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ mgbidi nke onye kpuchiri agba. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-25.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ nke onye zuru. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-25.s.s1.explain: Fallen leaves bụ akwụkwọ osisi dara n'onwe ha, ọ bụghị akwụkwọ osisi onye wụsara. Ọ nwere ihe ọ pụtara nke mmezu, ọ bụghị passive.
l-e-h1-b06-25.s.s2.model.0: Fallen leaves abụghị akwụkwọ osisi onye wụsara; akwụkwọ osisi ahụ dara n'onwe ha, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ bụ passive adịghị mma.
l-e-h1-b06-25.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere n'ihi na fall bụ omume a na-eme n'onwe ya, ya mere past participle pụtara "adaala", nke na-egosi mmezu.

l-e-h1-b06-33.title: have + past participle ọ na-abụ present perfect mgbe niile?
l-e-h1-b06-33.goal: Lelee ma echiche “have + past participle bụ present perfect mgbe niile” bụ eziokwu; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ ndị na-emegide ya.
l-e-h1-b06-33.material: Echiche: Ụdị have + past participle na-abụ present perfect mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide ya.
l-e-h1-b06-33.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ present perfect. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-33.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ present perfect. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-33.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ present perfect. Ọ bụ ihe atụ dabara n’echiche ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-33.s.s1.explain: will have left bụ future perfect. Ọ bụ ezie na o nwere ụdị have + past participle, mgbe agbakwunyere will, ọ bụghị present perfect.
l-e-h1-b06-33.s.s2.model.0: By noon, I will have left nwere have left mgbe will gasịrị; ya mere ọ bụ future perfect, nke na-egosi na echiche na ọ bụ present perfect mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-33.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe will bu ya ụzọ, ọ pụtara ihe ga-emecha n’ọdịnihu; ya mere n’agbanyeghị otu ụdị ahụ, ọ bụghị present perfect.

l-e-h1-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: Ọnụọgụ okwu enweghị ihe ọ gbasara n'ịhọrọ relative word.

l-e-h1-b04-18.s.s1.r.b: Ọbụna na otu isiokwu, nhazi nwere ike ịdị iche.

l-e-h1-b04-34.material: A: I have painted the fence. It looks great. B: I have been painting the fence. My arms hurt. Chọta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa oge abụọ ahụ.

l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.r.a: Nha nke ihe enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na oge.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.r.b: Isiokwu nke ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ bụ I.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ na-agwa nsonaazụ ma ọ bụ omume gara n'ihu
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.o.d: Ma ahịrị okwu bụ nkwenye ma ọ bụ mmegide
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ bụ ahịrị okwu nkwenye.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s1.explain: N'A, a na-ahụ nsonaazụ e mezuru ugbu a. N'B, omume ịkpuchi agba gara n'ihu ma aka na-egbu mgbu.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s2.model.0: A na-agwa nsonaazụ na-adị mma ma B na-agwa omume gara n'ihu nke mere ka aka gbuo mgbu, ya mere ma ọ bụ nsonaazụ ma ọ bụ omume na-aga n'ihu bụ ụkpụrụ.
l-e-h1-b04-34.s.s2.model.1: Nsonaazụ nke ihe omume e mezuru na-ewere present perfect ma omume gara n'ihu na-ewere present perfect continuous, ya mere ị nwere ike ikewa ha site n'ụkpụrụ a.

l-e-h1-b05-02.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ nwere ụdị oge gara aga called.

l-e-h1-b05-18.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ isi echiche nke ederede. Ọ bụ ahịrịokwu jikọtara.
l-e-h1-b05-18.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ ihe kpatara ịgụ akwụkwọ ji arụtụ okwu. Ọ bụ ahịrịokwu jikọtara.
l-e-h1-b05-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ uru ọzọ nke ịgụ akwụkwọ. Ọ bụ ahịrịokwu jikọtara.
l-e-h1-b05-18.s.s1.explain: Ndị ọzọ na-ekwu banyere uru nke ịgụ akwụkwọ. Wheel nke bicycle enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịgụ akwụkwọ.
l-e-h1-b05-18.s.s2.model.0: Naanị (3) bụ banyere bicycle ma ndị ọzọ na-ekwu banyere uru nke ịgụ akwụkwọ, ya mere (3) na-apụ n'ọgbụgba.
l-e-h1-b05-18.s.s2.model.1: Ọ naghị akwado isi echiche, ya mere (3), nke enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịgụ akwụkwọ, kwesịrị iwepụ.

l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke a na-eji n'ụzọ dị iche n'ihe ndị ọzọ?
l-e-h1-b05-26.title: -ing ọ pụtara “na-eme” ka ọ bụ “e ji eme ihe”?
l-e-h1-b05-26.goal: Chọpụta ozi dị mkpa iji amata ọrụ -ing dị n’ihu aha, kọwaa ihe kpatara nhọrọ ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-26.material: a sleeping baby, a running dog, a crying child, a sleeping bag. Kewaa ha dịka ọrụ -ing dị n’ihu aha si dị.
l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụ present participle pụtara “na-ebe akwa.” Ọ nọ n’otu ìgwè ahụ na ndị ọzọ.
l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ present participle pụtara “na-agba ọsọ.” Ọ nọ n’otu ìgwè ahụ na ndị ọzọ.
l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ present participle pụtara “na-ehi ụra.” Ọ nọ n’otu ìgwè ahụ na ndị ọzọ.
l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s1.explain: A sleeping bag bụ akpa e ji ehi ụra; ya mere ọ bụ gerund na-akọwa ebumnuche. Ndị ọzọ pụtara “ime ihe.”
l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s2.model.0: sleeping bag bụ gerund nke pụtara ebumnuche ihi ụra; ndị ọzọ bụ omume na-aga n’ihu, ya mere ojiji ha dị iche.
l-e-h1-b05-26.s.s2.model.1: Akpa ahụ anaghị ehi ụra; a na-eji ya ehi ụra. Naanị a sleeping bag na-egosi ebumnuche.

l-e-h1-b05-34.title: Kedu okwu abụghị ihe ngosi nke perfect tense?
l-e-h1-b05-34.goal: Chọpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa n'ezie iji mata okwu oge a na-ejikarị na present perfect, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-h1-b05-34.material: N'etiti already, yet, just, na tomorrow, chọta nke abụghị ihe ngosi a na-ejikarị na present perfect.
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s1.prompt: Kedu otu abụghị ihe ngosi nke present perfect?
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s1.r.b: A na-ejikarị ya na present perfect, dị ka n'Have you ... yet?
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: A na-ejikarị ya na present perfect, dị ka n'I have already ...
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: A na-ejikarị ya na present perfect, dị ka n'I have just ...
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s1.explain: tomorrow bụ oge ọdịnihu, ya mere a naghị eji ya na present perfect. Ndị ọzọ na-adaba nke ọma na present perfect.
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: tomorrow na-atụ aka n'oge nke na-abịabeghị, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe ngosi nke present perfect.
l-e-h1-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: already, yet, na just na-ekwu banyere nsonaazụ ruo ugbu a, mana tomorrow bụ ọdịnihu, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe ngosi.

l-e-h1-b06-02.title: Gịnị ka ị na-eji ahọrọ relative adverb?
l-e-h1-b06-02.goal: Chọpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa kpamkpam iji kpebie relative adverbs where, when, na why, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-h1-b06-02.material: I remember the day when we met. This is the place where we met. Nobody knows the reason why we met. where, when, why: chọta ọkọlọtọ maka ịhọrọ n'etiti ha.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọkọlọtọ achọrọ iji kpebie relative adverb?
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede enweghị ihe metụtara relative adverbs.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.o.b: Ma relative clause bụ oge gara aga ma ọ bụ ugbu a
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: Tense anaghị ekewa where, when, na why.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.o.c: Ma antecedent bụ ebe, oge, ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.explain: Jiri where maka ebe, when maka oge, na why maka ihe kpatara. Lelee ihe noun tupu ya bụ.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: Ebe na-anata where, ụbọchị na-anata when, ma ihe kpatara na-anata why, ya mere udi antecedent bụ ọkọlọtọ.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrịokwu atọ niile relative clause nwere otu udi, ya mere ị ga-ele ma noun tupu ya bụ ebe, oge, ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara.

l-e-h1-b06-10.title: Gịnị ka ị na-eji ahọrọ n'etiti Meanwhile na Afterward?
l-e-h1-b06-10.goal: Chọpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam iji họrọ n'etiti Meanwhile na Afterward, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-h1-b06-10.material: I cooked dinner. ___, my sister set the table. Chọta ọkwa maka ikpebi ma Meanwhile ma ọ bụ Afterward na-aga n'oghere ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọkwa a chọrọ kpamkpam iji họrọ okwu njikọ?
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.o.a: Okwu ole ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ nwere
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụọgụ okwu enweghị ike igosi mmekọrịta oge.
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.o.b: Ma ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ nwere otu isiokwu
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.r.b: Isiokwu dị iche anaghị ekpebi mmekọrịta ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma ihe omume abụọ ahụ mere n'otu oge ma ọ bụ otu n'azụ nke ọzọ
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma okwu njikọ ahụ na-abịa na mmalite kpamkpam nke ahịrịokwu
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọnọdụ ahụ e kwuchaala. Mmekọrịta oge bụ ọkwa ahụ.
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na isi nri na ịtọ tebụl mere n'otu oge, jiri Meanwhile. Ọ bụrụ na ha mere otu n'azụ nke ọzọ, jiri Afterward.
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ihe omume abụọ na-eme n'otu oge, ị na-eji Meanwhile, ya mere ọkwa ahụ bụ ma ọ bụ otu oge ma ọ bụ otu n'azụ nke ọzọ.
l-e-h1-b06-10.s.s2.model.1: Okwu njikọ na-egosi mmekọrịta oge, ya mere ị ghaghị ilele ma ọ bụ n'otu oge ma ọ bụ n'usoro, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ okwu ma ọ bụ isiokwu.

l-e-h1-b06-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrị okwu nkọwa na-akwado (1) site n'ọnụọgụ?
l-e-h1-b06-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ahịrị okwu isiokwu n'onwe ya. Ọ bụghị ahịrị okwu nkwado.
l-e-h1-b06-18.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ekwu nsonaazụ, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ.
l-e-h1-b06-18.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ echiche onye dere ya, ya mere ọ nweghị ọnụọgụ.
l-e-h1-b06-18.s.s1.explain: (2) na-egosi na (1) bụ eziokwu site n'ọnụọgụ na-ekwu na ọ toro site na mmadụ 200 ruo 300.
l-e-h1-b06-18.s.s2.model.0: Ọnụọgụ na-ekwu na ọ toro site na mmadụ 200 ruo 300 na-egosi (1) n'ụzọ doro anya, ya mere (2) bụ ahịrị okwu nkwado.

l-e-h1-b06-26.title: Gịnị ka nkebiokwu participle pụtara?
l-e-h1-b06-26.goal: Chọpụta kedu ụkpụrụ (ozi) achọrọ n'ezie iji chọta ihe nkebiokwu participle na-egosi (oge ma ọ bụ ihe kpatara), ma kọwaa ihe kpatara i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-h1-b06-26.material: A: Feeling tired, I went to bed. B: Entering the room, I turned on the light. Chọta ụkpụrụ maka ịmata ihe nkebiokwu participle abụọ ahụ pụtara.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.prompt: Gịnị ka nkebiokwu participle ọ bụla na-egosi?
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.o.a: A bụ oge, B bụ ihe kpatara
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.a: Onye ahụ gara ihi ụra n'ihi ike ọgwụgwụ, ya mere A bụ ihe kpatara.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.o.b: A bụ ihe kpatara, B bụ oge
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.c: B na-ekwu banyere oge e kwanyere ìhè mgbe a na-abanye n'ụlọ.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.explain: A pụtara ihe kpatara, ịga ihi ụra n'ihi ike ọgwụgwụ, ma B pụtara oge, ikwanye ìhè mgbe a na-abanye n'ụlọ.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s2.model.0: Ike ọgwụgwụ bụ ihe kpatara ịga ihi ụra, ya mere A bụ ihe kpatara, ma e kwanyere ìhè n'oge ịbanye, ya mere B bụ oge.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s2.model.1: Ihe nkebiokwu participle pụtara na-ekpebi site na mmekọrịta ya na nkebiokwu isi, ya mere ị kwesịrị ilele ma akụkụ nke mbụ bụ ihe kpatara nke abụọ ma ọ bụ oge.

l-e-h1-b07-02.title: Who ma ọ bụ whom, gịnị ka anyị kwesịrị ilele?
l-e-h1-b07-02.goal: Iji chọpụta who ma ọ bụ whom n'relative clause nwere I think etinyere, kpebie ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị ji họrọ ya otú ahụ.
l-e-h1-b07-02.material: This is the singer ___ I think is the most talented in our school. Tinye ma who ma ọ bụ whom n'oghere.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Iji kewaa who na whom, gịnị ka ị ga-elele?
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Ma is na-abịa mgbe oghere n'enweghị subject, ọbụna ma ị wepụ I think
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ mmadụ, ma who ma whom bụ ndị a pụrụ ịhọrọ, ya mere ị nweghị ike ikewa ha.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: Ma e nwere otu singer ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ abụghị ihe na-ekewa who na whom.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.d: Ma I think dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Eziokwu na etinyere ya anaghị ekpebi ikpe.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ I think, ọ na-aghọ '...singer ___ is the most talented' ya mere oghere bụ subject nke is. Ya mere ọ bụ who.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ I think, verb is na-abịa ozugbo mgbe oghere, ya mere oghere bụ ọnọdụ subject ma who ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Ịbụ mmadụ na-emetụta ma who ma whom, ya mere ị ga-ele ma ọ bụ subject nke verb.

l-e-h1-b01-11.title: Oge ole ka enwere ike hapụ relative pronoun?
l-e-h1-b01-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ịhapụ relative pronoun, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b01-11.material: Enwere ike hapụ: the book (that) I read, the song (which) she wrote. Enweghị ike hapụ: the girl who sings, the dog that barks.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu kwekọrọ n'ihe atụ niile?
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.a: Enwere ike hapụ that, ma enweghị ike hapụ who
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: E nwere ihe atụ ebe e hapụkwara which (the song she wrote).
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.b: Enwere ike hapụ ya mgbe subject na-abịa mgbe relative pronoun
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.c: Enwere ike hapụ ya maka ihe naanị
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: The dog that barks abụghị ihe, ma enweghị ike hapụ ya.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.d: Enwere ike hapụ ya mgbe ahịrịokwu dị mkpụmkpụ
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ịhapụ ya.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe okwu e hapụrụ, subject na-abịa (I, she), mgbe okwu enweghị ike hapụ, ngwaa na-abịa (sings, barks).
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe subject na-abịa mgbe ya, dịka n'I read na she wrote, ọ nọ n'ọnọdụ object, ya mere enwere ike hapụ ya.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe ngwaa na-abịa ozugbo mgbe ya, dịka n'sings na barks, relative pronoun bụ subject, ya mere enweghị ike hapụ ya.

l-e-h1-b01-14.title: Iwu -ing na -ed n'participle phrases
l-e-h1-b01-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke -ing na -ed n'participle phrases, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu kwekọrọ n'ahịrịokwu anọ niile?
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.o.a: -ing pụtara oge gara aga, -ed pụtakwa ugbu a
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.r.a: Ọ naghị ekewa site n'oge ngwaa kama site n'ma subject na-eme ihe ma ọ bụ na-enweta ihe.
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.r.b: Ọ nweghị ahịrịokwu atụ ọ bụla nwere -ed pụtara ọdịnihu.
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.o.c: -ing bụ ihe subject na-eme, -ed bụkwa ọnọdụ subject na-enweta
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.o.d: Participle phrase na-abịa naanị na njedebe nke ahịrịokwu
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.r.d: N'ahịrịokwu anọ niile, participle phrase dị na mmalite.
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s1.explain: Walking na Seeing bụ omume subject na-eme, ma Tired na Surprised bụ ọnọdụ subject na-enweta.
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s2.model.0: Walking na Seeing bụ omume subject na-eme, ma Tired na Surprised bụ ọnọdụ o na-enweta, ya mere a pụrụ ịkewa ha.
l-e-h1-b01-14.s.s2.model.1: Subject a hapụrụ nke participle phrase bụ otu dị ka subject nke clause na-esote, ya mere ị na-ahọrọ -ing ma ọ bụ -ed dabere n'ma ọ bụ omume ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ.

l-e-h1-b01-15.title: Otu esi eji past progressive na simple past
l-e-h1-b01-15.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke otu esi eji past progressive na simple past, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b01-15.material: I was cooking when the phone rang. / While we were eating, the lights went out. / I cooked when the phone rang. (pụtara na amalitere m isi nri mgbe ekwentị ma ịkpọ)
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu dabara n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ?
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.a: Jiri past progressive maka ihe na-aga n'ihu, ma simple past maka nke bịara n'etiti
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.b: Jiri past progressive maka nke bịara n'etiti, ma simple past maka ndabere
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.b: Rang na went out bụ ihe bịara n'etiti, ha dịkwa n'simple past.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.c: Jiri naanị past progressive maka ihe abụọ ahụ
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu ọ bụla na-ejikwa simple past (rang, went out).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: Ihe pụtara bụ otu mgbe niile ọbụna ma tense dị iche
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu nke atọ pụtara ihe dị iche na ahịrịokwu nke mbụ.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.explain: A na-ekwu ihe ndabere nke na-aga n'ihu site na past progressive (was cooking), ma a na-ekwu ihe mere mgbe ahụ site na simple past (rang).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Ihe na-aga n'ihu, isi nri, bụ was cooking, ma ekwentị nke tiri n'etiti bụ rang, ya mere ndabere bụ past progressive ma nke bịara n'etiti bụ simple past.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: I cooked pụtara na m sịrị nri mgbe ekwentị ma ịkpọ, ya mere ị pụrụ ịhụ iwu na ihe pụtara na-agbanwe na tense.

l-e-h1-b02-11.title: Iwu quantity expression + of which/whom
l-e-h1-b02-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ ojiji of which na of whom, jirizie ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee iwu ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: A na-eji of which maka mmadụ, a na-ejikwa of whom maka ihe
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: E ji of which maka ihe (akwụkwọ, ụgbọala), of whom maka mmadụ (ndị otu).
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Ka quantity expression gachara, ọ na-akọ akụkụ nke ihe dum e kwuru na mbụ.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: Ngwaa dị na relative clause na-adị otu mgbe niile
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Ngwaa na-agbanwe dabere n'ọnụọgụ nke bu ya ụzọ, dịka were, are, is.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: of whom na of which na-aga n'ihu kpamkpam nke ahịrịokwu
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: A jiri okwu abụọ ahụ n'etiti ahịrịokwu.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Dịka n'two of which na most of whom, ha na-atụ aka n'akụkụ nke ihe niile a kpọtụrụ aha na mbụ.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Ha na-atụ aka n'akụkụ nke ihe niile, dịka two out of five books na most of 20 members, ya mere ọ bụ otu iwu.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: of which ma ọ bụ of whom mgbe okwu ọnụọgụ na-ezo aka azụ n'aha nke bu ya ụzọ, ya mere ọ na-akpọ akụkụ.

l-e-h1-b02-12.title: Gịnị na-abịa mgbe although na despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke udi na-abịa mgbe although na despite, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b02-12.material: Ziri ezi: Although it was cold, we swam. / Despite the cold, we swam. Na-ezighị ezi: Despite it was cold, we swam. / Although the cold, we swam.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu kwekọrọ n'ahịrịokwu atụ ndị ahụ?
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Clause na-abịa mgbe ma although ma despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.a: Despite it was cold bụ otu n'ime ahịrịokwu atụ na-ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: Clause na-abịa mgbe although, noun phrase na-abịakwa mgbe despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: N'ahịrịokwu atụ ziri ezi, a jiri although na mmalite kpamkpam nke ahịrịokwu.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: despite nwere ihe megidere although pụtara
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: Okwu abụọ ahụ pụtara otu ihe, ‘in spite of’.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: although na-eduga isiokwu + ngwaa, despite na-eduga aha (nkebi okwu). Ihe ọ pụtara bụ otu.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Naanị ahịrịokwu atụ ebe Although it was cold bụ clause na Despite the cold bụ noun phrase ka ziri ezi, ya mere nke a bụ iwu ahụ.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu atụ na-ezighị ezi na-ezighị ezi n'ihi na ha na-etinye clause mgbe despite na noun phrase mgbe although, ya mere ị nwere ike ịhụ iwu ahụ.

l-e-h1-b02-13.material: Aha ọma: How Bees Help Plants / Why We Need Sleep. Aha adịghị ike: Bees / Things.
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu aha ọma ndị ahụ na-ekekọrịta?
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.o.a: E dere ya naanị dị ka ajụjụ
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.r.a: How Bees Help Plants abụghị ajụjụ.
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.o.b: Ọ na-eji naanị otu okwu isiokwu
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.r.b: Aha ndị adịghị ike bụ naanị otu okwu isiokwu.
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.r.c: Aha ndị adịghị ike dị mkpụmkpụ karịa.
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.o.d: Ọ na-ekwu isiokwu na isi ihe gbasara ya ọnụ
l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s1.explain: Aha ọma na-ekwu isiokwu (bees, sleep) na isi ihe gbasara ya (help plants, need) ọnụ.

l-e-h1-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Dịka How Bees Help Plants, ọ nwere isi ihe na-ekwu gịnị bụ otu esi, ya mere ị nwere ike ịmata ọdịnaya nke ederede ahụ.

l-e-h1-b02-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ọnọdụ participle na-akọwa aha, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b02-14.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu kwekọrọ n'okwu anọ ahụ?
l-e-h1-b02-14.s.s1.o.a: Participle na-abịa mgbe aha mgbe niile
l-e-h1-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Ụfọdụ participles na-abịa tupu aha, dịka n'a sleeping child.
l-e-h1-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Otu participle na-aga tupu aha, mgbe a gbakwunyere okwu ndị ọzọ ọ na-aga mgbe aha
l-e-h1-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: -ing na-abịa naanị tupu, -ed na-abịakwa naanị mgbe

l-e-h1-b03-12.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dịghị otu n'ime ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ nwere usoro oge.

l-e-h1-b03-12.s.s2.model.0: Ebe ọ na-atụnyere ihe abụọ, dịka nwamba na nkịta ma ọ bụ ugwu na ndịda, whereas na-egosi ọdịiche.
l-e-h1-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ otu iwu, n'ihi na ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ na-ekwu otú akụkụ ndị dị n'ihu na n'azụ si dị iche.

l-e-h1-b03-14.title: Iwu maka with + aha + participle
l-e-h1-b03-14.goal: Chọpụta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụdị with + aha + participle, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.o.a: -ing mgbe aha ahụ na-eme ihe, -ed mgbe e mere ya ihe ma ọ bụ ọ nọ n'ọnọdụ e metụtara ya.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.o.b: -ed na-abịa mgbe with gasịrị mgbe niile.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.r.b: Sun shining na engine running na-eji -ing.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.o.c: -ing pụtara oge gara aga, -ed pụtara ọdịnihu.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.o.d: Ụdị isi nke ngwaa na-abịa mgbe with gasịrị.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, ọ bụghị ụdị isi ngwaa.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s1.explain: N'ụdị with + aha + participle, jiri -ing ma aha ahụ na-eme ihe n'onwe ya; jiri -ed ma ọ nọ n'ọnọdụ ihe metụrụ.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Anyị na-eji -ing n'ihi na anyanwụ na injin na-eme ihe n'onwe ha, -ed maka windo nọ n'ọnọdụ emechiri.
l-e-h1-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: Otu nkebi with ahụ na-eji ụdị abụọ dabere na ma aha ahụ na-eme ihe ka ọ bụ na-anata ihe ahụ.

l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s1.o.a: Mgbe a na-akọ okwu mmadụ, oge ngwaa na-alaghachi otu nzọụkwụ n'oge gara aga.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s1.o.b: Oge ngwaa anaghị agbanwe mgbe ọ bụla.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s1.r.b: Oge ngwaa gbanwere n'ahịrịokwu ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s1.o.c: Oge ngwaa niile na-agbanwe gaa n'ọdịnihu.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s1.r.c: Ha gbanwere gaa n'oge gara aga, ọ bụghị ọdịnihu.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a na-akọ okwu site n'oge gara aga dịka said, are na-aghọ were, have na-aghọ had, will na-aghọkwa would.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s2.model.0: Are ghọrọ were, have finished ghọrọ had finished, will ghọkwara would; ha niile laghachiri otu nzọụkwụ n'oge gara aga, ya mere nke a bụ iwu.
l-e-h1-b03-15.s.s2.model.1: Ebe a na-akọ okwu e kwuru n'oge gara aga, oge ngwaa na-alaghachi otu nzọụkwụ n'oge gara aga.

l-e-h1-b04-03.title: Ị̀ na-eji that mgbe preposition?
l-e-h1-b04-03.goal: Chọta iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke relative pronouns e ji na prepositions, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu maka relative pronouns na prepositions?
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.o.a: A naghị eji that ozugbo mgbe preposition
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.o.b: Preposition enweghị ike ịbịa na njedebe kpamkpam nke relative clause
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.r.b: ✓ the room that I slept in nwere ya na njedebe kpamkpam.
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.o.c: which enweghị ike iji ozugbo mgbe preposition nakwa
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.r.c: ✓ in which I slept bụ ahịrịokwu ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.o.d: that nwere ike iji ebe ọ bụla n'ọnọdụ which
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.r.d: ✗ Ahịrịokwu ahụ na-etinye that ozugbo mgbe preposition.
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye preposition tupu relative pronoun, jiri which ma ọ bụ whom. that enweghị ike ịbịa ozugbo mgbe preposition.
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s2.model.0: in which ziri ezi ma in that adịghị mma, ya mere iwu bụ na a naghị eji that ozugbo mgbe preposition.
l-e-h1-b04-03.s.s2.model.1: that na-eso I slept in, ebe e bugara preposition n'azụ, ya mere ọ bụrụ na a tinye preposition n'ihu, jiri which.

l-e-h1-b04-11.title: Kedu verb na-abịa mgbe either ... or?
l-e-h1-b04-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ọnụọgụ verb na either A or B, chọta iwu ahụ ma kwuo ya, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu maka ịhọrọ ọnụọgụ nke verb?
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: E nwere ahịrịokwu ✓ nke na-eji is.
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s1.o.b: Verb na-adabara A nke mbụ mgbe niile
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: N'etiti ahịrịokwu ✓, otu na-eji verb nke ọnụọgụ ya dị iche na A.
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s1.r.c: E nwere ahịrịokwu ✓ nke na-eji are.
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s1.explain: N'either A or B, verb na-adabara ọnụọgụ nke B dị nso. Ọ bụrụ na the guests dị nso, jiri are; ọ bụrụ na the cook dị nso, jiri is.
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na B bụ the guests, jiri are; ọ bụrụ na B bụ the cook, jiri is, ya mere verb na-adabara B dị nso.
l-e-h1-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na verb dabara A, ahịrịokwu ✓ ga-abụ nke na-ezighị ezi, ya mere ịdabara B bụ iwu.

l-e-h1-b04-19.title: Kedu mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu tupu na mgbe But?
l-e-h1-b04-19.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu tupu na mgbe But na However, chọta iwu ahụ ma kwuo ya, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu maka mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu tupu na mgbe But na However?
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.o.a: Nke mbụ bụ echiche onye dere, nke abụọ bụ ihe atụ ya
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: N'ederede abụọ ahụ, akụkụ nke abụọ bụ echiche megidere nke mbụ.
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.o.b: Tupu na mgbe na-ekwughachi otu nkwupụta
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrịokwu nke abụọ na-ekwu ihe megidere nke mbụ.
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.o.c: Nke abụọ bụ nsonaazụ nke nke mbụ
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụghị nsonaazụ kama ọ bụ echiche megidere.
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.o.d: Nke mbụ bụ echiche nkịtị, nke abụọ bụ echiche onye dere
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s1.explain: Echiche nkịtị na-abịa tupu But na However, ma mgbe ha onye dere na-agbanwe ya.
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: N'A na B abụọ, akụkụ mbụ bụ nkwenye nkịtị ma akụkụ nke abụọ bụ nkwupụta megidere, ya mere akụkụ nke abụọ bụ echiche onye dere.
l-e-h1-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: But na However bụ ihe ngosi na-agbanwe ihe, ya mere isi ihe onye dere dị n'ahịrịokwu nke abụọ.

l-e-h1-b04-27.s.s1.prompt: Kedu iwu mgbe spend na catch?
l-e-h1-b04-27.s.s1.r.a: Cleaning na digging abụghị past participles.
l-e-h1-b04-27.s.s1.o.b: Jiri -ing mgbe oge ma ọ bụ ihe
l-e-h1-b04-27.s.s1.r.c: A na-eji -ing, dịka n'cleaning na digging.

l-e-h1-b04-27.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu ✓ na-eji -ing dịka cleaning na digging, ndị ✗ jikwa to, ya mere -ing bụ iwu ahụ.
l-e-h1-b04-27.s.s2.model.1: To clean na to dig e ji akara na-ezighị ezi, ya mere ị ghaghị iji -ing.

l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.a: A na-eji so naanị n'ahịrịokwu nkwenye, ma such naanị n'ahịrịokwu njụ
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu anọ ahụ niile bụ ahịrịokwu nkwenye.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.b: Mgbe so, naanị adjective; mgbe such, (a) + adjective + noun
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.c: so na such nwere ike ịgbanwe n'otu ebe
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu ndị e gbanwere (✗) adịghị mma.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.d: so a long trip bụkwa okwu ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu nwere so a long trip bụ ahịrịokwu ✗.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe so, naanị adjective na-abịa. Mgbe such, (a) + adjective + noun na-abịa.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: so tired nwere naanị adjective, ma such a long trip nwere noun, ya mere ha na-ekewa site n'ihe na-abịa mgbe ha.

l-e-h1-b05-27.goal: Chọta iwu site n’ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụdị ngwaa na-eso ngwaa nghọta, jiri ọnọdụ ọhụrụ nwalee ya.

l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s1.o.a: A gaghị eji ngwaa nkịtị; a na-eji naanị -ing
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s1.r.a: ✓ I heard the baby cry bụ ngwaa n’ụdị nkịtị.
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s1.o.c: A gaghị eji -ing; naanị ngwaa nkịtị ka a na-eji
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s1.r.c: ✓ I heard the baby crying jiri -ing.
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s1.o.d: Jiri ngwaa nkịtị ma ọ bụ -ing mgbe object gasịrị
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ngwaa nghọta dịka hear na watch gasịrị, ngwaa nkịtị ma ọ bụ -ing na-abịa. A naghị eji to-infinitive.
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu ✓ na-eji ngwaa nkịtị ma ọ bụ -ing dịka cry, crying, na move; nke ✗ na-eji to. Ya mere iwu bụ ngwaa nkịtị ma ọ bụ -ing.
l-e-h1-b05-27.s.s2.model.1: to cry na to move akara ha dị ka ihe na-ezighị ezi; ya mere a naghị eji to-infinitive, ma ngwaa nkịtị na -ing ga-ekwe omume.

l-e-h1-b07-03.title: Ichọta iwu maka whether na if
l-e-h1-b07-03.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke whether na if nke na-ewebata noun clauses, wee lelee iwu ahụ n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-h1-b07-03.material: ○ I wonder if the shop is open. ○ I wonder whether the shop is open. ○ Whether the shop is open is unclear. × If the shop is open is unclear. Chọta iwu ahụ ma jupụta oghere.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: ___ the plan works depends on the weather. Gịnị dabara n'oghere?
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: Unless pụtara "if not," ya mere ọ bụ condition clause. Ọ nweghị ike ịbanye n'ọnọdụ subject.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: Because na-amalite reason clause, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịbụ subject nke depends.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: If clause enweghị ike ịbanye n'ọnọdụ subject nke ahịrịokwu (ihe atụ × ikpeazụ).
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.explain: Naanị whether ka a na-eji maka noun clause n'ọnọdụ subject. if nwere ike ịbanye naanị n'ọnọdụ object nke verb dị ka wonder.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: N'ihe atụ ndị ahụ, naanị Whether bụ ○ ma If bụ × n'ọnọdụ subject, ya mere jiri Whether n'oghere kwa.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: if pụtara naanị n'ọnọdụ object mgbe wonder, ya mere ahịrịokwu a, ebe oghere bụ ọnọdụ subject, chọrọ Whether.

l-e-h1-b02-18.material: Ederede nwere paragraf 5. Paragraf ọ bụla nwere ahịrịokwu isi 1 na ahịrịokwu nkọwa nkwado 3 ruo 4.
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu ole dị n'ederede niile?
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-agụ ahịrịokwu 1~1.5 n'paragraf ọ bụla.
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-agụ ahịrịokwu 2~3 n'paragraf ọ bụla.
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-agụ ahịrịokwu 8~10 n'paragraf ọ bụla.
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s1.explain: Otu paragraf bụ 1+3~4, nke bụ ahịrịokwu 4~5. Na paragraf 5, nke ahụ bụ ahịrịokwu 20~25.
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s2.model.0: Otu paragraf nwere ahịrịokwu 4~5, ya mere paragraf 5 nwere ahịrịokwu 20~25.
l-e-h1-b02-18.s.s2.model.1: Paragraf ọ bụla nwere ahịrịokwu 4 ruo 5, ya mere ịmịkọrịta site na 5 na-enye ahịrịokwu 20 ruo 25.

l-e-h1-b02-19.title: Ahịrịokwu ole dị n'edemede nke okwu 250?
l-e-h1-b02-19.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu dị n'edemede, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b02-19.material: Ị chọrọ ịchọta ma kaa akara otu participial phrase n'ahịrịokwu ọ bụla. Edemede ahụ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 250, ahịrịokwu na-enwekwa okwu 12 n'nkezi.
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu ole ka ị ga-akaa akara?
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-agụ otu ahịrịokwu dị ka okwu 50.
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-agụ otu ahịrịokwu dị ka okwu 25.
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke a na-agụ otu ahịrịokwu dị ka okwu 5.
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s1.explain: 250÷12 bụ ihe dị ka 21. Ọnụọgụ dị nso bụ ihe dị ka 20.
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s2.model.0: 250 kewara site na 12 bụ ihe dị ka 21, ya mere tụọ atụmatụ ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 20.
l-e-h1-b02-19.s.s2.model.1: 12×20=240, ya mere okwu 250 bụ ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 20.

l-e-h1-b02-20.title: N'okwu e mụtara n'ụbọchị 20, ole ka ị na-echeta?
l-e-h1-b02-20.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu ị na-echeta, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b02-20.material: Anọ m na-amụta okwu ọhụrụ 12 kwa ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 20. A na-ekwu na ihe dị ka 1/4 nke ha ka echefuru.
l-e-h1-b02-20.s.s1.prompt: Ihe dị ka okwu ole ka ị na-echeta?
l-e-h1-b02-20.s.s1.r.c: Nke a na-agụ naanị ọnụọgụ okwu echefuru.
l-e-h1-b02-20.s.s1.r.d: Nke a anaghị wepụ okwu echefuru.
l-e-h1-b02-20.s.s1.explain: 12×20=okwu 240, ma iwepụ 1/4 nke ha, nke bụ 60, na-ahapụ 180.
l-e-h1-b02-20.s.s2.model.0: Okwu e mụtara bụ 12×20=240, iwepụ 60 echefuru na-ahapụ ihe dị ka 180.
l-e-h1-b02-20.s.s2.model.1: Ị na-echeta 3/4, ya mere tụọ atụmatụ 3/4 nke 240, nke bụ 180.

l-e-h1-b03-16.title: Ajụjụ nkebi ahịrịokwu relative ole ka m ga-edozi?
l-e-h1-b03-16.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ nsogbu relative clause a ga-edozi, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b03-16.material: Ana m edozi nsogbu relative clause 6 kwa ụbọchị, ụbọchị 5 n'izu, ruo izu 4.
l-e-h1-b03-16.s.s1.prompt: Nsogbu ole ka a ga-edozi n'ozuzu?
l-e-h1-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Nke a gụrụ naanị otu (1) ụbọchị n'ime izu.
l-e-h1-b03-16.s.s1.r.c: Nke a gụrụ oge ahụ dịka izu 8.
l-e-h1-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ nsogbu 6×5=30 kwa izu, ya mere nsogbu 120 n'ime izu 4.
l-e-h1-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: Ana m edozi nsogbu 6 kwa ụbọchị ruo ụbọchị 20, ya mere 6×20, ihe dị ka nsogbu 120.

l-e-h1-b03-17.material: E nwere kaadị njikọ 24. Ihe dị ka 1/3 n'ime ha na-egosi ọdịiche, dịka however.

l-e-h1-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: 1/3 pụtara 1 n’ime 3, ya mere n’ime kaadị 24, tụọ kaadị 8.

l-e-h1-b03-19.title: Nkebi ahịrịokwu participle -ed ole dị?
l-e-h1-b03-19.goal: Tụọ ọnụọgụ nkebi participle malitere na -ed, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke dabara, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b03-19.material: Achịkọtala m ahịrịokwu 36 nwere nkebi participle. Ihe dị ka 2/3 malitere na -ing, ndị fọdụrụ malitere na -ed.
l-e-h1-b03-19.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu malitere na -ing.
l-e-h1-b03-19.s.s1.r.d: Nke a chere na ha niile bụ -ed.

l-e-h1-b03-19.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na -ing bụ 2/3, -ed bụ 1/3, ya mere 1/3 nke 36 bụ 12.

l-e-h1-b04-04.title: Ihe dị ka okwu ole ka m na-amaghị?
l-e-h1-b04-04.goal: Tụ anya ọnụọgụ okwu amaghị n'ederede okwu 600, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-h1-b04-04.material: Ederede ahụ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 600. Ihe dị ka okwu 3 ruo 5 n'okwu 100 ọ bụla bụ ndị m na-amaghị. Tụ anya ọnụọgụ okwu amaghị n'ederede niile.
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oke kwesịrị ekwesị maka ọnụọgụ okwu amaghị?
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s1.r.a: Nke a bụ ọnụọgụ n'okwu 100. Maka okwu 600 ọ karịrị nke a.
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 10 n'okwu 100, nke buru oke ibu.
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 17 n'okwu 100, nke buru oke ibu.
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s1.explain: 600 bụ okpukpu 6 nke 100. Okpukpu 6 nke 3 bụ 18, ma okpukpu 6 nke 5 bụ 30.
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s2.model.0: Okwu 600 bụ okpukpu 6 nke okwu 100, ya mere ọ si na 3×6=18 ruo 5×6=30.
l-e-h1-b04-04.s.s2.model.1: Ịchịkọta ọnụọgụ n'okwu 100 ugboro 6, m na-atụ anya ihe dị ka 18 ruo 30.

l-e-h1-b05-20.goal: Mee atụmatụ ụbọchị ole a ga-eji rụchaa akwụkwọ mgbatị relative clause, họrọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b05-20.material: Akwụkwọ mgbatị relative clause nwere peeji 60. Ị na-eme peeji 6~8 kwa ụbọchị. Mee atụmatụ ụbọchị ole a ga-eji rụchaa ya.
l-e-h1-b05-20.s.s1.prompt: Oke ụbọchị ole ka dabara adaba iji rụchaa ya?
l-e-h1-b05-20.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụgodị na i mee peeji 8 kwa ụbọchị, ọ ga-ewe ụbọchị 7.
l-e-h1-b05-20.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ ihe dị ka peeji 3 kwa ụbọchị, nke dị nwayọọ nke ukwuu.

l-e-h1-b05-20.s.s2.model.1: Ịkekọrịta na ọnụọgụ peeji abụọ dị na nsọtụ na-enye ụbọchị 8 ruo 10; ya mere oke a dabara.

l-e-h1-b05-28.material: E nwere kaadị -ing na -ed 100. Ihe dị ka 15~20% n’ime ha bụ participle na-egosi mmetụta. Mee atụmatụ ọnụọgụ kaadị ndị ahụ.

l-e-h1-b05-36.goal: Tụọ ohere na okwu usoro niile ziri ezi mgbe etinyere ha n'enweghị usoro, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-h1-b05-36.material: Tinye okwu anọ First, Next, Then, na Finally n'ebe anọ n'enweghị usoro, otu nke ọ bụla. Tụọ ohere na usoro niile ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-36.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ohere kwesịrị ekwesị nke ịmara ha niile nke ọma?
l-e-h1-b05-36.s.s1.r.a: E nwere nhazi 24, ya mere ọ bụghị ọkara.
l-e-h1-b05-36.s.s1.r.b: Ọ dị obere karịa otu n'ime 4 nke ukwuu.
l-e-h1-b05-36.s.s1.r.d: 0.1% ga-abụ ihe dị ka otu n'ime 1000.
l-e-h1-b05-36.s.s1.explain: Ọnụọgụ ụzọ e nwere ike itinye okwu anọ bụ 4×3×2×1=24. Naanị 1 ziri ezi, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 4%.

l-e-h1-b06-12.title: Okwu ole ka dị n'otu paragraf?
l-e-h1-b06-12.goal: Tụọ atụmatụ ogologo otu paragraf n'ederede nwere paragraf 5, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b06-12.material: Ederede ahụ nwere ihe dị ka okwu 600 ma nwee paragraf 5. Were na paragraf ndị ahụ dị ihe dị ka otu ogologo, tụọ atụmatụ ọnụọgụ okwu dị n'otu paragraf.
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ọnụọgụ okwu kwesịrị ekwesị maka otu paragraf?
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s1.r.a: Okwu 12 dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu maka otu paragraf.
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka paragraf 2 na ọkara uru.
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ okwu nke ederede niile.
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s1.explain: 600÷5=120. Otu paragraf bụ ihe dị ka okwu 120.
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s2.model.0: Ikewa okwu 600 niile n'paragraf 5 na-enye 120, ya mere otu paragraf bụ ihe dị ka okwu 120.
l-e-h1-b06-12.s.s2.model.1: Paragraf ndị ahụ dị ihe dị ka otu ogologo, ya mere tụọ atụmatụ okwu 120, nke bụ 600 kewara site na 5.

l-e-h1-b06-20.goal: Tụọ anya ohere na azịza niile ziri ezi mgbe e tinyere who, which, na that n'enweghị usoro, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b06-20.material: Mejupụta ebe efu 4 site na who, which, ma ọ bụ that n'enweghị usoro. Tụọ anya ohere na 4 niile ziri ezi site n'ihe ọdịmma.
l-e-h1-b06-20.s.s1.r.b: Inweta 4 niile nke ọma siri ike karịa nke ukwuu.
l-e-h1-b06-20.s.s1.r.c: Ịhọrọ site n'nhọrọ 3 ugboro anọ enweghị ike inye ọkara.
l-e-h1-b06-20.s.s1.r.d: Ị nweghị ike inweta 80% nke ọma site n'ihe ọdịmma.
l-e-h1-b06-20.s.s1.explain: Ohere nke ịbụ nke ziri ezi n'otu ebe efu bụ 1/3. Maka ebe efu 4 ọ bụ 1 n'ime 81, ya mere ihe dị ka 1%.
l-e-h1-b06-20.s.s2.model.0: Site na nhọrọ 3 n'ebe efu 4 ọ bụla e nwere ụzọ 3×3×3×3=81 ma naanị 1 ziri ezi, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 1%.

l-e-h1-b06-28.title: Peeji ole ka edemede ga-abụ?
l-e-h1-b06-28.goal: Tụọ anya ogologo edemede na-eji okwu na-ejikọta, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ ókè kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b06-28.material: Ederede ahụ nwere ihe dị ka okwu 1,200. Otu peeji akwụkwọ nwere ihe dị ka okwu 400. Mee atụmatụ peeji ole ederede ahụ ga-ewe.
l-e-h1-b06-28.s.s1.r.a: Ị ga-ede okwu 400 ugboro atọ iji ruo okwu 1,200.
l-e-h1-b06-28.s.s1.r.c: Otu peeji ga-enwe ihe dị ka okwu 120, nke pere mpe nke ukwuu.
l-e-h1-b06-28.s.s1.r.d: Otu peeji ga-enwe ihe dị ka okwu 40.
l-e-h1-b06-28.s.s1.explain: 1,200÷400=3. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka peeji 3.
l-e-h1-b06-28.s.s2.model.0: Ikekọrịta okwu 1,200 na okwu 400 kwa peeji na-enye 3; ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka peeji 3.
l-e-h1-b06-28.s.s2.model.1: Otu peeji nwere okwu 400, ya mere peeji atọ ga-enwe okwu 1,200, nke dabara.

l-e-h1-b06-36.title: Nnwale ahụ ga-ewe nkeji ole?
l-e-h1-b06-36.goal: Mee atụmatụ oge a ga-eji dozie ajụjụ nkebi participle 25, họrọ oke kwesịrị ekwesị ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b06-36.material: Nnwale nkebi participle nwere ajụjụ 25. Ajụjụ ọ bụla na-ewe ihe dị ka nkeji 1.2 ruo 1.6. Mee atụmatụ oge niile.
l-e-h1-b06-36.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 0.5 n’ajụjụ ọ bụla, ọsọ ọsọ karịa kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-h1-b06-36.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 2.4 n’ajụjụ ọ bụla.
l-e-h1-b06-36.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 3.6 n’ajụjụ ọ bụla.
l-e-h1-b06-36.s.s1.explain: 25×1.2=30, 25×1.6=40. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 30 ruo 40.
l-e-h1-b06-36.s.s2.model.0: Maka ajụjụ 25, nkeji 1.2 nke ọ bụla na-enye nkeji 30, nkeji 1.6 na-enye nkeji 40; ya mere ọ bụ nkeji 30 ruo 40.
l-e-h1-b06-36.s.s2.model.1: Ịmụba na nsọtụ abụọ nke oge ajụjụ ọ bụla na-enye nkeji 30 ruo 40; ya mere oke a dabara.

l-e-h1-b07-04.title: Oge ịgụ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ ngwa ngwa
l-e-h1-b07-04.goal: Tụọ oge ịgụ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ nke ederede nwere paragraph 6 ngwa ngwa, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b07-04.material: Ederede nke okwu 900 nwere paragraph 6. Ahịrịokwu mbụ nke paragraph ọ bụla bụ ihe dị ka okwu 20, ma m na-agụ ihe dị ka okwu 150 n'nkeji 1. Tụọ oge ịgụ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ ngwa ngwa.
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s1.prompt: Kedu oge kwesịrị ekwesị iji gụọ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ?
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s1.r.a: N'sekọnd 10 ana m agụ ihe dị ka okwu 25. Nke ahụ ezughị maka okwu 120.
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: N'nkeji 15 ana m agụ ihe karịrị okwu 2000. Nke ahụ dị ogologo karịa ederede ahụ.
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ oge ọ na-ewe ịgụ ederede niile.
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s1.explain: 6 × 20 = okwu 120, ma 120 ÷ 150 bụ ntakịrị erughị nkeji 1. Ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 1.
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: Ahịrịokwu mbụ bụ 6 × 20 = okwu 120, ya mere ịgụ okwu 150 n'nkeji 1 na-ewe erughị nkeji 1.
l-e-h1-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: Ederede niile nke okwu 900 na-ewe nkeji 6, mana ịgụ naanị ahịrịokwu mbụ bụ okwu 120, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 1.

l-e-h1-b01-21.s.s1.r.c: ③ bụ nsonaazụ sitere n'njehie dị n'②.

l-e-h1-b03-21.s.s2.model.1: Iji the thing na-adakọ na what, ya mere jiri that, dị ka n'I did the thing that I could.

l-e-h1-b04-05.title: Ịhọrọ ụdị progressive: ebee ka ọ gbagwojuru?
l-e-h1-b04-05.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke ọrụ maka I was reading when the lights went out, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, iji chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru.
l-e-h1-b04-05.material: Ahịrịokwu: I was reading when the lights went out. Ọrụ na-akọwa nhọrọ nke tense. ① Ịgụ akwụkwọ na-aga n'ihu mgbe ọkụ gbara ② Ọkụ ịgba bụ ihe mere n'otu ntabi anya ③ Omume na-aga n'ihu bụ simple past, ma ihe n'otu ntabi anya bụ past progressive ④ Ya mere I read when the lights were going out ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Ịgụ akwụkwọ na-aga n'ihu mgbe ọkụ gbara
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: Ọ kwekọrọ n'ihe ahịrịokwu ahụ pụtara. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ kwekọrọ n'ihe ahịrịokwu ahụ pụtara. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Ọkụ ịgba bụ ihe mere n'otu ntabi anya
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Omume na-aga n'ihu bụ simple past, nke n'otu ntabi anya bụ past progressive
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ naanị nsonaazụ sitere n'③, ọ bụghị ebe mbụ gbagwojuru.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Omume na-aga n'ihu na-eji past progressive (was reading), ma ihe n'otu ntabi anya nke na-abanye na-eji simple past (went out). ③ dị n'azụ.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s2.model.0: A ga-eji past progressive maka omume na-aga n'ihu na simple past maka ihe n'otu ntabi anya, ya mere ③, nke kwuru ya n'azụ, adịghị mma.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s2.model.1: ③ kọwara ya n'ụzọ megidere, ya mere ahịrịokwu na-ezighi ezi n'④ sitere n'ime ya.

l-e-h1-b04-13.title: Idozi whoever: ebe ọ gabigara ụzọ?
l-e-h1-b04-13.goal: Soro ngwọta nke Give it to whoever needs it, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge, wee chọta ma dozie ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ.
l-e-h1-b04-13.material: Ahịrịokwu: Give it to whoever needs it. Otu nwa akwụkwọ dozie ya site n'ikwu na a ga-agbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ whomever. ① Mgbe to na-abịa whoever needs it niile ② Clause niile bụ object nke to, ya mere whoever n'ime clause ga-abụrịrị n'ikpe object kwa ③ Ya mere gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ whomever ④ Give it to whomever needs it
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.o.a: ① Mgbe to na-abịa clause whoever niile
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: Nhazi nwere clause mgbe to ziri ezi. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.o.b: ② whoever n'ime clause ga-abụrịrị n'ikpe object kwa
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ya mere gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ whomever
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụ naanị nsonaazụ nke ②, ọ bụghị ebe mbụ gabigara ụzọ.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.explain: N'ime clause, whoever bụ subject nke needs. Ọbụna ma clause niile bụ object nke to, ọrụ n'ime clause na-ekpebi ikpe.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: N'ime clause, whoever bụ subject nke needs, ya mere a chọrọ ikpe subject, mana ② kpebiri ya site n'ọrụ nke clause niile.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: Clause whoever nwere ọrụ dị iche n'ime na n'èzí, ya mere ọ gabigara ụzọ n'②, ma whoever ziri ezi.

l-e-h1-b05-05.title: Idozi nkebiokwu since: ebee ka o si gaa ezighi ezi?
l-e-h1-b05-05.goal: Soro ngwọta nke I have been happy since I moved here, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'nzọụkwụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-aga ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b05-05.material: Ahịrị okwu: I have been happy since I moved here. Otu nwa akwụkwọ sịrị na a ga-agbanwe moved ka ọ bụrụ have moved. ① Nkebiokwu isi bụ ọnọdụ na-aga n'ihu ruo ugbu a, ya mere present perfect ziri ezi ② Nkebiokwu mgbe since ga-ejikwa present perfect ③ Ya mere a na-edozi ya ka ọ bụrụ since I have moved here ④ Nke a bụ azịza
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Nkebiokwu isi bụ ọnọdụ na-aga n'ihu, ya mere present perfect
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.r.a: Nkọwa gbasara nkebiokwu isi ziri ezi. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Nkebiokwu since ga-ejikwa present perfect
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Dozie ya ka ọ bụrụ since I have moved here
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.d: ④ Were nke a dị ka azịza
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.explain: Nkebiokwu mgbe since nke na-agwa ebe a malitere dị n'oge gara aga. Ịkwaga ebe a bụ ihe omume doro anya n'oge gara aga.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: Nkebiokwu mgbe since bụ ihe omume gara aga na-agwa mgbe ọ malitere, ya mere oge gara aga moved ziri ezi ma ② adịghị mma.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: Main clause na-ekwu present perfect, ya mere since clause achọghị present perfect nakwa.

l-e-h1-b05-13.title: Idozi relative clause: ebee ka ọ gbagwojuru?
l-e-h1-b05-13.goal: Soro ngwọta The man whom I met him is kind, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu n'otu, mgbe ahụ chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b05-13.material: Ahịrịokwu: The man whom I met him is kind. Ngwọta: ① whom na-atụ aka n'antecedent the man ② Relative clause chọrọ object him n'iche ③ Ya mere ahịrịokwu ziri ezi ④ Edozila ya
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s1.o.a: ① whom na-atụ aka n'the man
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s1.r.a: Ọ ziri ezi na relative pronoun na-atụ aka n'the man. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s1.o.b: ② A chọrọ object him n'iche
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ya mere ahịrịokwu ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s1.explain: whom na-arụ ọrụ dị ka object nke met. Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri him ọzọ, e nwere objects abụọ, ya mere hichapụ him.
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s2.model.0: whom bụworị object nke met, ya mere ②, nke kwuru na a chọrọ him, adịghị mma.
l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Relative pronoun na-anọchi object, ya mere iji him ọzọ na-eme ka ha na-agbakwụnye ibe ha.

l-e-h1-b05-21.title: Ịghọta unless: Ebee ka echiche ahụ si hie ụzọ?
l-e-h1-b05-21.goal: Soro usoro ngwọta nke You will fail unless you study, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara ihe na ihe si na ya pụta, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b05-21.material: Ahịrịokwu: You will fail unless you study. Ngwọta: ① unless pụtara “ọ bụrụ na i meghị” ② Ya mere ahịrịokwu a pụtara “Ọ bụrụ na ị mụọ, ị ga-ada” ③ Ọ bụ ihe ijuanya na ị ga-ada ma ị mụọ ④ Kpebie na onye dere ya ezighị ezi

l-e-h1-b05-21.s.s1.r.a: Ihe unless pụtara ziri ezi. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Ọ pụtara “Ọ bụrụ na ị mụọ, ị ga-ada”
l-e-h1-b05-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ọ bụ ihe ijuanya na ị ga-ada ma ị mụọ
l-e-h1-b05-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ Kpebie na onye dere ya ezighị ezi

l-e-h1-b05-29.title: Ime Ntụpụta: Ebee ka echiche ahụ si hie ụzọ?
l-e-h1-b05-29.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ ngwọta nke ntụpụta sitere n’ederede gbasara ọba akwụkwọ mechiri emechi, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b05-29.material: Ederede: Ọba akwụkwọ ahụ dara jụụ. E dobere oche n’elu tebụl. Ihe e dere n’ọnụ ụzọ kwuru, “Mechiri maka nrụzi ruo Monday.” Ngwọta: ① Ọba akwụkwọ ahụ dara jụụ ② E dobere oche n’elu tebụl ③ Ihe ịrịba ama ahụ kwuru na e mechiri ya maka nrụzi ruo Monday ④ Ya mere e mechiela ọba akwụkwọ ahụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s1.o.a: ① Ọba akwụkwọ ahụ dara jụụ
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s1.o.b: ② E dobere oche n’elu tebụl
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s1.o.c: ③ O kwuru na e mechiri ya maka nrụzi ruo Monday
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s1.r.c: Otu ihe ahụ ka ihe ịrịba ama kwuru. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s1.o.d: ④ E mechiela ọba akwụkwọ ahụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s1.explain: Ihe ịrịba ama ahụ kwuru ruo Monday. Ọ dịghị ihe n’ederede kwuru na a ga-emechi ya ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s2.model.0: Ihe ịrịba ama ahụ kwuru ruo Monday; ya mere ④ nke kwuru na e mechiri ya ruo mgbe ebighị ebi adabaghị n’ederede.
l-e-h1-b05-29.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụ nrụzi nwa oge, ọ bụghị mmechi na-adịgide adịgide; ya mere a ga-edozi ④.

l-e-h1-b05-37.title: Idozi Participial Phrase: ebe ọ gabigara ụzọ?
l-e-h1-b05-37.goal: Soro ngwọta nke Seeing from the hill, the town is tiny, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, otu nzọụkwụ n'otu oge, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-agabiga ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b05-37.material: Ahịrịokwu: Seeing from the hill, the town is tiny. Ngwọta: ① Subject pụtara nke participial phrase bụ obodo ② Obodo bụ onye na-ele ③ Ya mere active Seeing ziri ezi ④ Edozila ya
l-e-h1-b05-37.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụ subject nke main clause. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-37.s.s1.explain: Obodo ahụ bụ onye a na-ele. Ọ bụ passive, ya mere Seen from the hill ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-37.s.s2.model.0: Obodo ahụ abụghị onye na-ahụ kama ọ bụ onye a na-ahụ, ya mere ọ ga-abụrịrị Seen, nke na-eme ② ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-37.s.s2.model.1: Obodo enweghị ike ịhụ n'onwe ya, ya mere past participle Seen, nke nwere ihe passive pụtara, ziri ezi.

l-e-h1-b06-05.title: Ịrụzi oge ngwaa: ebee ka ọ gbagwojuru?
l-e-h1-b06-05.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke nkọwa maka ahịrịokwu gbasara igbu oge n'ihi na bọs mebiri, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma rụzie ya.
l-e-h1-b06-05.material: Ahịrịokwu: I was late because the bus has broken down. Nkọwa: ① Bọs ịmebi bịara tupu m igbu oge ② A na-ede ihe omume mbụ n'present perfect ③ Ya mere has broken ziri ezi ④ Ejila rụzie ya
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Bọs ịmebi bịara tupu igbu oge
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s1.r.a: Egburu m oge n'ihi mmebi ahụ, ya mere usoro ahụ ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s1.o.b: ② A na-ede ihe omume mbụ n'present perfect
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ya mere has broken ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s1.explain: Ihe omume nke mere tupu oge ụfọdụ n'oge gara aga dị n'past perfect. Rụzie ya ka ọ bụrụ had broken down.
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s2.model.0: Ihe omume tupu oge gara aga was ga-adị n'past perfect, ya mere ②, nke kwuru present perfect, ezighị ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-05.s.s2.model.1: I was late dị n'oge gara aga, ya mere mmebi ahụ nke bịara tupu ya ga-abụ had broken down.

l-e-h1-b06-13.title: Ịrụzi ngwaa relative clause: ebee ka ọ gbagwojuru?
l-e-h1-b06-13.goal: Soro nzọụkwụ nke nkọwa maka The books that is on the shelf, ma ọ bụ usoro ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ site n'nzọụkwụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ gbagwojuru ma rụzie ya.
l-e-h1-b06-13.material: Ahịrịokwu: The books that is on the shelf are mine. Nkọwa: ① Antecedent nke that bụ the books ② Ọ bụrụ na antecedent bụ plural, ngwaa dị n'relative clause bụkwa plural ③ Ya mere gbanwee is ka ọ bụrụ are ④ Wee gbanwee are mine nke na-abịa n'azụ ka ọ bụrụ is mine kwa
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.o.a: ① Antecedent nke that bụ the books
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.r.a: That bụ okwu relative pronoun na-atụ aka. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.o.b: ② Antecedent plural na-eme relative clause bụrụkwa plural
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.r.b: Iwu nkwekọrịta ziri ezi. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.o.c: ③ Gbanwee is ka ọ bụrụ are
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-esote ② n'ụzọ okike. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.o.d: ④ Gbanwee are mine ka ọ bụrụ is mine kwa
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s1.explain: Are mine bụ ngwaa nke isi clause, isiokwu ya The books bụkwa plural, ya mere ọ ziri ezi. Naanị ihe a ga-arụzi bụ is dị n'relative clause.
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s2.model.0: Isiokwu nke isi clause, The books, bụ plural, ya mere are mine ziri ezi, mana ④ gbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ is mine.
l-e-h1-b06-13.s.s2.model.1: Naanị ngwaa nke relative clause chọrọ nrụzi, isi clause ahụ ziri ezi n'ihe ọ bụla, ya mere ④ bụ ebe ọ gbagwojuru.

l-e-h1-b06-21.title: However ọ ziri ezi?
l-e-h1-b06-21.goal: Soro nkọwa nke ahịrị okwu gbasara ịhụ tii n'anya ma ịṅụ ya kwa ụbọchị, ma ọ bụ agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ, nzọụkwụ n'nzọụkwụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-aga ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b06-21.material: Ahịrị okwu: I like tea; however, I drink it every day. Nkọwa: ① However na-ejikọta ihe megidere ihe bịara na mbụ ② Ihe bịara na mbụ bụ "I like tea" ③ Ịṅụ ya kwa ụbọchị mgbe ị hụrụ ya n'anya abụghị ihe a na-atụ anya ④ Ya mere however ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.o.a: ① However na-ewebata ihe megidere ihe bịara na mbụ
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.r.a: Ihe however pụtara ziri ezi. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.o.b: ② Ihe bịara na mbụ bụ "I like tea"
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.r.b: Ọ kwekọrọ n'akụkụ nke mbụ nke ahịrị okwu ahụ. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ịṅụ ya kwa ụbọchị mgbe ị hụrụ ya n'anya abụghị ihe a na-atụ anya
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ya mere however ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị hụrụ ihe n'anya, ọ bụ ihe okike iṅụ ya ugboro ugboro. Ọ bụghị ihe a na-atụghị anya, ya mere therefore dabara karị karịa however.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị hụrụ ihe n'anya, ọ bụ ihe okike iṅụ ya ugboro ugboro, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe a na-atụghị anya. Nke ahụ na-eme ③ adịghị mma, ma therefore ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-21.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụghị mmegide nke ihe bịara na mbụ, ya mere enweghị ike iji however, ma ọ gara ezighi ezi malite na ③.

l-e-h1-b06-29.goal: Soro nkọwa akara n’ime ụlọ ebe mmadụ nọbeghị anya, chọta ebe mbụ o si hie ụzọ ma dozie ya.
l-e-h1-b06-29.material: Ederede: Ofe ahụ ka na-ekupụta uzuoku. Akwụkwọ dina ghe oghe n’elu tebụl. Ọnụ ụzọ azụ ghe oghe ntakịrị. Nkọwa: ① Ofe na-ekupụta uzuoku, ya mere e siri ya ọhụrụ ② Akwụkwọ ghe oghe, ya mere mmadụ kwụsịrị ịgụ ya ③ Ọnụ ụzọ azụ ghe oghe, ya mere mmadụ pụrụ nwa oge ④ Ya mere ọ bụ ụlọ onye ọ bụla hapụrụ ogologo oge gara aga
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.o.a: ① Uzuoku na-egosi na e siri ya ọhụrụ
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.r.a: Ị pụrụ ịmata nke a site n’ahịrịokwu mbụ. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.

l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.r.b: Ị pụrụ ịmata nke a site n’ahịrịokwu nke abụọ. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.o.c: ③ Ọnụ ụzọ azụ ghe oghe, ya mere mmadụ pụrụ nwa oge
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.r.c: Ị pụrụ ịmata nke a site n’ahịrịokwu nke atọ. Nzọụkwụ a ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.o.d: ④ Ọ bụ ụlọ onye ọ bụla hapụrụ ogologo oge gara aga
l-e-h1-b06-29.s.s1.explain: Ofe ka na-ekupụta uzuoku na akwụkwọ ghe oghe bụ akara na mmadụ nọ ebe ahụ n’oge na-adịbeghị anya. Ikwu na ha hapụrụ ogologo oge gara aga megidere ederede.

l-e-h1-b07-05.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta maka ịgbanwe 'Since I had read the book twice, I skipped chapter one.' ka ọ bụrụ participial clause. ① Subjects nke clauses abụọ bụ otu I ② Hichapụ Since na subject I ③ Mee ka had read dị mkpụmkpụ ka ọ bụrụ Reading ④ Azịza: Reading the book twice, I skipped chapter one.

l-e-h1-b01-26.goal: Dee ọzọ ahịrịokwu nwere relative clause e mere ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ n'udi dị iche (okwu mgbakọ, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe.
l-e-h1-b01-26.material: My aunt, who is a nurse, lives nearby. Iji debe otu ihe pụtara, hapụ ‘who is’ ma mee ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ.

l-e-h1-b01-26.s.s1.r.c: N'enweghị commas, ọ dịghị doo anya na ọ bụ ozi agbakwunyere.
l-e-h1-b01-26.s.s1.r.d: N'enweghị a, ahịrịokwu ahụ na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya.
l-e-h1-b01-26.s.s1.explain: Relative clause agbakwunyere site na commas nwere ike ịdị mkpụmkpụ site n'ịhapụ who is ma debe naanị a nurse.

l-e-h1-b01-29.goal: Deghachi nkebiokwu participle nke dochiri nkebiokwu Because n'ụdị dị iche (okwu, tebụl, eserese, ma ọ bụ okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ ji pụta otu ihe.
l-e-h1-b01-29.material: Because I was left alone, I felt lonely. Anyị chọrọ ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ nkebiokwu participle nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara.

l-e-h1-b05-15.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere Otherwise na Therefore, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karịa, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-h1-b05-15.material: Wear a coat. ___, you will catch a cold. Otu n'ime Otherwise na Therefore na-abanye n'ebe efu.
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s1.o.a: Therefore: nsonaazụ tupu ya na-eme ka ị were oyi
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s1.r.a: Iyi uwe oyi abụghị ihe na-akpata oyi.
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s1.o.b: Otherwise: ọ pụtara 'ọ bụrụ na ị meghị otú ahụ'
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s1.r.c: Ihe ha pụtara dị iche, ya mere naanị otu na-ada nkịtị.
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s1.explain: Otherwise pụtara 'ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị'. Ọ pụtara na ọ bụrụ na ị yighị uwe oyi, ị ga-eweta oyi.
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-ekwu banyere ikpe nke ịyighị uwe oyi, ya mere Otherwise, nke pụtara 'ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị', ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-15.s.s2.model.1: Therefore na-ekwu banyere nsonaazụ tupu ya, ma uwe oyi abụghị ihe na-akpata oyi, ya mere ọ dabaghị.

l-e-h1-b05-23.title: Ọ bụ by ka ọ bụ until?
l-e-h1-b05-23.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ banyere by na until, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b05-23.material: Ị ga-emecha ọrụ ụlọ tupu elekere 5 (oge ọ bụla tupu elekere 5). A: I will finish it by five. B: I will finish it until five.
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s1.o.a: A na-eji by egosi oge ikpeazụ a ga-emecha ihe.
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s1.o.b: B: until pụtara ịmecha ihe tupu oge ahụ
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s1.r.b: A na-eji until maka ihe na-aga n’ihu ruo oge ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s1.r.c: by bụ oge ngwụcha, until na-egosi ihe na-aga n’ihu; ya mere ha nwere ihe dị iche.
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s1.explain: by bụ oge ikpeazụ a ga-emecha ihe, ebe until na-egosi ihe na-aga n’ihu ruo oge ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ oge ikpeazụ iji mechaa tupu elekere 5; ya mere A, nke ji by, ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-23.s.s2.model.1: until pụtara na imecha ahụ na-aga n’ihu ruo elekere 5; ya mere ọ dabaghị n’ọnọdụ a.

l-e-h1-b05-31.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ gbasara ntụpụta abụọ, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b05-31.material: Ederede: Windo ụlọ ahịa ahụ gbara ọchịchịrị, ihe ịrịba ama kwuru “Anyị ga-alọghachi n’elekere 2:00.” A: Emechiela ụlọ ahịa ahụ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi. B: Emechiela ụlọ ahịa ahụ nwa oge.
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụpụta ka ederede na-akwado nke ọma?
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.o.a: A: Emechiela ụlọ ahịa ahụ kpamkpam
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.r.a: Back at 2:00 pụtara na ọ ga-alọghachi n'oge na-adịghị anya.
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.o.b: B: Ụlọ ahịa mechiri nwa oge
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.r.c: A na-emegide ihe ngosi dị n'ederede.
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.r.d: Otu n'ime ha nwere nkwado site n'akara ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s1.explain: Akara ahụ kwuru na ọ ga-alọghachi n'2. Ntụle na ọ mechiri nwa oge dabara n'ihe ngosi dị n'ederede.
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s2.model.0: Akara Back at 2:00 pụtara na ọ ga-alọghachi n'oge na-adịghị anya, ya mere B, nke na-ekwu na ọ mechiri nwa oge, ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-31.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ọ mechiri ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, ọ gaghị ekwu na ọ ga-alọghachi, ya mere A na-emegide ederede ahụ.

l-e-h1-b05-39.title: Ọ bụ Judging ma ọ bụ Judged?
l-e-h1-b05-39.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ nke idiomatic participle phrase, họrọ nke ka kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.
l-e-h1-b05-39.material: A: Judging by the sky, it will rain soon. B: Judged by the sky, it will rain soon. Họrọ nke ziri ezi n'ime ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ.
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s1.o.a: A: Judging by bụ idiom pụtara "judging from"
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s1.o.b: B: Igwe bụ ihe a na-ekpe ikpe, ya mere Judged
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s1.r.b: Subject nke main clause bụ it, ya mere igwe abụghị ihe a na-ekpe ikpe.
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s1.r.c: Idiom ahụ aghọọla nke e kwụsiri ike dị ka Judging by naanị.
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s1.r.d: A bụ okwu ziri ezi a na-eji n'ebe niile.
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s1.explain: Judging by bụ idiomatic participle phrase nke a na-eji n'agbanyeghị subject. Ọ pụtara "judging from".
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s2.model.0: Judging by the sky bụ idiom pụtara "judging from the sky" n'agbanyeghị subject, ya mere A ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b05-39.s.s2.model.1: Idiomatic participle phrases anaghị adị mkpa ịdabara subject nke main clause, ya mere Judging by n'A ziri ezi.

l-e-h1-b06-07.title: To whom ma ọ bụ To who?
l-e-h1-b06-07.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara relative na interrogative pronouns mgbe preposition, họrọ nke dabara adaba karịa, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b06-07.material: N'ide nke ọdịnala, jiri nke a maka "Who did you speak to?" A: To whom did you speak? B: To who did you speak?
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Ọ bụ object mgbe preposition, ya mere whom
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.o.b: B: who dị mfe karịa, ya mere ọ dabara adaba karịa
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.r.b: N'ide nke ọdịnala, jiri whom mgbe preposition.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.r.d: A bụ ahịrịokwu ziri ezi, nke ọdịnala.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s1.explain: Jiri whom maka object ozugbo mgbe preposition to. N'ide nke ọdịnala, To whom ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s2.model.0: Ebe object nke to na-ewe whom objective, ya mere To whom did you speak ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b06-07.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe preposition bụ ebe object, ya mere B nwere who subjective adabaghị n'ide nke ọdịnala.

l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s1.r.a: Ikwu na ị nwere obi ụtọ na-aga n'ụzọ dị iche site n'ikwu na ọ siri ike.

l-e-h1-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ ihe a na-atụghị anya ya na ha nwere obi ụtọ ọbụlagodi na ọ siri ike, ya mere Nevertheless, nke pụtara ọdịiche, ziri ezi.

l-e-h1-b06-39.goal: Tụlee ụzọ ma ọ bụ echiche abụọ maka nkebi participle malitere na there being, họrọ nke dabara adaba ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-h1-b06-39.material: Enweghị oche, ya mere anyị guzoro. A: There being no seats, we stood. B: Being no seats, we stood.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.o.a: A: A chọrọ isiokwu nwere ihe ọ pụtara, there, tupu participle.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.o.b: B: Ọ bụ otu ihe ahụ na isiokwu nkebi ahịrịokwu bụ isi, ya mere e deghị isiokwu.

l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.r.d: A bụ nkebi participle dabara adaba.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s1.explain: There nke There were no seats na-anọgide n’ihu participle, ghọọ There being.... Ọ dị iche na isiokwu bụ we, ya mere e dere ya iche.
l-e-h1-b06-39.s.s2.model.0: Isiokwu there nke nkebi participle dị iche na isiokwu we nke nkebi ahịrịokwu bụ isi; ya mere a ga-ede ya iche dịka There being.

l-e-h1-b07-07.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara ọnụọgụ nke verb na-aga na 'the + past participle,' họrọ nke ka kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-h1-b07-07.material: The injured ___ taken to the hospital. A: injured bụ adjective, ya mere a na-eji singular verb was. B: the injured pụtara "ndị merụrụ ahụ," ya mere a na-eji plural verb were.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Ọ bụ adjective, ya mere ọ na-anata singular verb
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: the + participle anaghị apụta otu ihe, kama "ndị ~."
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.b: B: Ọ pụtara "ndị merụrụ ahụ," ya mere ọ na-anata plural verb
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: was na were enweghị ike ịbụ ndị ziri ezi abụọ n'otu ahịrịokwu.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.d: Abụọ ezighị ezi ma injureds ziri ezi
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: Agbakwunyela -s n'participle; jiri the injured dị ka ọ dị.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.explain: A na-ewere the + past participle dị ka plural, na-apụta "ndị ~." Ya mere were ziri ezi.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: the injured pụtara ọtụtụ ndị merụrụ ahụ, ya mere a ga-eji plural verb were.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ma injured bụ adjective, mgbe a na-eji ya na the ọ na-atụ aka n'ndị mmadụ, ya mere B kwesịrị ekwesị karịa.

l-e-h1-b07-08.material: Dee text message nye enyi. Ọnọdụ: ① Kwuo na ọ bụ elekere 3 echi ② Gosi na ị ga-anọ n'ụgbọ elu n'oge ahụ ③ Jiri okwu 7 ma ọ bụ ihe erughị.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.r.a: will fly na-ekwu naanị banyere omume nke ife efe. Ọ pụtaghị ịnọ n'etiti ya.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.r.c: will have flown pụtara na ọ ga-agwụchaa tupu mgbe ahụ.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nwere okwu 8, ya mere ọ na-agafe ọnọdụ nke okwu 7 ma ọ bụ ihe erughị.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s1.explain: will be flying pụtara ịnọ n'etiti ya n'oge ahụ, ma ọ nwere okwu 7, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ atọ niile.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s2.model.0: will be flying pụtara ịnọ n'ụgbọ elu n'oge ahụ, ma ọ nwere okwu 7, ya mere ọ na-emezu ọnọdụ atọ niile.
l-e-h1-b07-08.s.s2.model.1: will fly enweghị ihe progressive pụtara, ma will have flown bụ ihe e mechara, ya mere will be flying bụ nke ziri ezi.
